title: Rational_Potato X Thread — Face, Seed, House, Image & Breath — 2026-09-18
purpose: Preserve a dense same-thread sequence in which Tim Dooley explicitly develops Face -> blessing/account -> single eye -> mustard seed -> thalamus/Potato-within -> Father's House -> living Tree -> self/face recognition -> image of God -> breath.
limitations: Text and status URLs are preserved exactly as supplied in conversation; this file does not independently establish theological claims.
Relative timestamps shown in the user capture are not converted into exact UTC timestamps unless an exact clock time was supplied.
Interlocutor replies are summarized only where needed to preserve sequence; they are not treated as Tim-originated theology.

thread_context.context_summary: An interlocutor jokes that a potato may be 'all face', asks about choice in facing Tim, says she has no potatoes, and asks who put the potato there. Tim turns the exchange into an explicit Face/Image/Breath/inner-Potato sequence.

occurrences.quote: I am God. You spineless foot stools wont say that shit to my face!
Yes. And God has a face. Go figure. I am GODS FACE. I am all Face. I appreciate you for facing me
occurrences.note: Directly prompted by the interlocutor's potato/all-face joke; the reply turns the joke into explicit theology.

occurrences.quote: I bless you , you are cute. I count that as a saving grace. Put it on your heavenly account!

try look thee within the flower pot of the mind. Maybe with a single eye alone, yee shall see a mustard seed shaped like potato, and be amazed. Thalamee thala you thalamus the potato is already living in you
A fathers house, a living tree, an earthly apple beyond the eye.
occurrences.note: Apple is project/Western Eden iconography; Genesis itself names fruit but not an apple.

occurrences.quote: Now yee know my face and know yours too
Yee are created in the image of God. The breath did, but who put the breath?

sequence: blessing entered on a heavenly account
thalamus becomes the inner dwelling image
Father's House and living Tree appear
image of God is named explicitly
breath closes the chain with a Creator/giver question
